title: agent-config
description: The agent's local protected configuration (docs/spec/04-agent-spec.md). Written at install time into a folder only administrators and SYSTEM can change; the network service can only read it. The server can never change it. Holds no secrets.

cabinetId.description: Only for the local test harness before enrollment. Once enrolled, the cabinet ID comes from the agent's certificate and this is ignored.

readOnlyMode.description: When true every write operation is rejected with read_only_mode, whatever the server sends.

hardwareIds.description: USB hardware IDs that identify the fingerprint scanner. Empty until collected; peripheral.status then lists candidates.

address.description: The site's sync cabinet, as an IPv4 address or host name. null until known; tests to it then report unavailable.

host.description: The platform server's agent API host name, also the name resolved by DNS tests. Its TLS certificate must chain to platform-ca.pem in the agent's data folder.

port.description: The agent API port. null until configured.

allowedTcpPorts.description: The only ports network.test may try over TCP. Empty means TCP tests are refused.

localHarness.description: When true the network service also reads command files from its local inbox folder, which only administrators can write. Off in production.

developmentShellEnabled.description: Development branch only. Separate from sessionsEnabled; never written by release installers.
